query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.creditLimit, p.currentBalance, p.companyId,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.totalAmount), 0) FROM sales s WHERE s.customerId = p.id AND s.saleType = 'A_PRAZO' AND s.status != 'CANCELLED') as totalSales,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cp.amount), 0) FROM customer_payments cp WHERE cp.customerId = p.id) as totalPayments,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cd.amount), 0) FROM customer_debits cd WHERE cd.customerId = p.id) as totalDebits
FROM partners p 
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Ricardo Pereira%'
LIMIT 5;
